As we prepare to finalize the format for Saturday's showcase, I need to hear from each team — digital, labor, and artist — on any constraints that could affect the final show structure. Please report anything that impacts the audience-voting segment, the volunteer performance, or the headliner appearance so I can approve the format and we can lock in the production schedule.
